response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry WHERE t.equipstatus IS NOT NULL AND s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS value FROM status_averages), first_kept AS (SELECT a.avg_pulse_rate, a.avg_pulse_rate - m.value AS excess_first FROM status_averages AS a CROSS JOIN first_mean AS m WHERE a.avg_pulse_rate > m.value), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS value FROM first_kept) SELECT AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_pulse_rate, AVG(k.excess_first) AS avg_excess_first_mean, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - m.value) AS avg_excess_second_mean FROM first_kept AS k CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m WHERE k.avg_pulse_rate > m.value

assumptions.assumption: A missing equipment status does not form a status group.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat signals whose telescope has a missing equipment status as one NULL status group.
